body:
**Blocks every `/system` slice. Must land first.**

### Why this is not optional

Middleware is the **only** authentication gate for the dashboard — `DashboardProviders` is theming-only and `DashboardShell` has no guard (zero matches for `redirect`, `getUser`, `useAuth`).

In `src/middleware.ts`, `protectedRoute = sortedRoutes.find(route => pathname.startsWith(route))` returns `undefined` when no `ROUTE_PERMISSIONS` key matches, and the entire `if (protectedRoute) { ... }` block is then skipped — it does **not** fall back to requiring login. Today all `/settings/*` paths are safe only because the generic `'/settings'` entry catches strays.

There is no such entry for `/system`. So the first `/system/*` page created without its own entry is **fully public and unauthenticated**, not merely under-permissioned.

### Change

- `src/lib/auth/action-roles.ts` — add `'/system': [PERMISSIONS.SYSTEM_VIEW_ALL_SETTINGS]` to `ROUTE_PERMISSIONS`.
- `src/middleware.ts` — add `'/system'` to `adminOnlyRoutes`.

No visible change; there is nothing at `/system` yet.

### Verify

- `npm test`
- Request `/system` from a signed-out browser and confirm it redirects to login rather than rendering.

Context: ADR-0004. Plan: `pin-the-grouping-rule-merry-firefly.md`.

title: Settings IA slice 0: middleware safety net before any /system route exists
